items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: They started to -- they gave Frank Sebastian a bill of goods and started white shows in Sebastian's Cotton Club for a short time.

ctx.x: Or some -- I don't know what it was. I think it was NTG. They started to -- they gave Frank Sebastian a bill of goods and started white shows in Sebastian's Cotton Club for a short time. During that time, they brought a band from the East out by the name of Ben Pollack. During that time, Ben Pollack sent for a very good trumpet player by the name of Harry James, who joined him for his first big-time band and they worked there for quite a while and during those times, the Height band toured up and down the coast.…
